title: Books & Movies
heading: Books & Movies
intro: A personal collection of books I'm reading or have finished, alongside movies, series, and anime that I've enjoyed or recommend.
booksIntro: Books I am currently reading, finished, or have queued up next on my reading list.
moviesIntro: Films, series, and anime that left a lasting impression on me.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.review: An insightful breakdown of how microscopic habits compound into massive personal and professional transformations. Currently implementing the two-minute rule.

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.review: Incredible deep dive into distributed data systems, replication, partitioning, and transaction models. Mandatory reading for software engineers.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
books.author: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
books.review: On my upcoming queue to sharpen my software engineering philosophy and daily craftsmanship.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.review: A masterclass in sci-fi cinema, human emotion, and theoretical physics. Hans Zimmer's soundtrack elevates every single sequence.

movies.title: Steins;Gate
movies.review: The pinnacle of time-travel narratives. Starts as a quirky otaku lab experiment in Akihabara and turns into an unforgettable, high-stakes thriller.

movies.title: Severance
movies.review: A chilling, retro-futuristic exploration of corporate alienation and identity bifurcation. The sterile 1980s computer terminal aesthetic is breathtaking.
